newsitem.title: UK: Fergie case over book on private life stopped.
newsitem.headline: Fergie case over book on private life stopped.

text.p: A London court case, in which the Duchess of York tried to prevent the publication of memoirs about her relationship with U.S. financier John Bryan, has been stopped, sources in the publishing industry said on Thursday.

"The matter has been resolved. An agreement has been reached with her lawyers," one source said. No further details were available but a news conference is due at 1530 GMT. The case was due to resume on Monday in open court and the Duchess, known as Fergie, could have been called to testify.
